theme: An open day, and a stack of Croatia bookings past due.
greeting: Morning, Dan — nothing's on the calendar today, which is exactly the opening you need. A cluster of p1 trip bookings has gone overdue and the window to lock them closes with your Sept 8 departure. Kids are with you and Mike in St. Pete.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: Travel p1, overdue since Aug 25. The issued fare shows 0 checked bags — verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags now, before airport-counter fees. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Travel p1, due today. One night in Cavtat after the charter disembarks at noon, airport-side for the 7:30 AM Sept 20 flight — plus the noon transfer from ACI Komolac. Book refundable; it has to be done from dry land before Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Close the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Travel p1, overdue since Aug 25. Sept 20–22 is still open — you land TPA the 20th, kids aren't picked up until the 22nd. Also glance at whether the pending Sept 27 St. Pete Airbnb converted from requested to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Valoris call with Martin at noon
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's one fixed point, a Teams call with Martin Steindl. Worth arriving with a clear read on what you want from Valoris and a couple of talking points.

flagged.title: Two roles from the job boards
flagged.detail: LinkedIn and Nexxt flagged a Viasat VP of Government Relations and a Hillel executive director posting — automated alerts, nothing owed in reply.

flagged.title: Mike's sailing-center options
flagged.detail: Mike forwarded St. Pete Sailing Center membership details for getting on the water before the Croatia course — shared, no ask attached.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, and the Midcoast Villager.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and basil are at their peak — a quick sauté lets them shine.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the whole open morning is yours for the trip bookings that have slipped past due.
Still clear; a good stretch to lock the Cavtat night and confirm the ticket's baggage before the fees climb.
Kids are with you and Mike in St. Pete; tomorrow's only fixed point is the noon Valoris call.
